models.name: Nanbeige4.3 33B
models.score_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (artificialanalysis.ai leaderboard JSON, fetched 2026-11-02) (highest dense model on v5; brand-new, 2026-10-24 - verify with own evals)
models.notes: Llama-architecture dense 33B, full attention on all 52 layers (KV ~6x heavier per token than Qwen3.8-27B). Scores level with Qwen3.8-27B Xhigh on v5 (AutomationBench 53% vs 48%, TB4 30% vs 6%, but HLE-D 7% vs 15%, Omniscience much lower). Tool calling UNVERIFIED.

models.name: Qwen3.8 27B
models.score_source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (artificialanalysis.ai leaderboard JSON, fetched 2026-11-02) - Xhigh effort. Medium 17.5, Low 15.7, Non-reasoning 10.0. (Was 34 on v4.3.)
models.notes: Released 2026-08-05. 48 Gated DeltaNet + 16 full-attn layers -> tiny KV. Strongest dense model <70B on AA v5 except Nanbeige4.3-33B (20.4). Speeds: RTX 4090 Q4_K_M 49 tok/s no-MTP (kingy.ai, b10453), 69.6 -> 147.5 tok/s code with MTP n-max 6 p-min 0.75 (81% accept); RTX 5090 ~172 tok/s code with MTP; RTX 3090 41.6 -> 66.4 with MTP n-max 2. VRAM Q4_K_M: 16.6GB @8K ctx, 20.3GB @64K (F16 KV).

models.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no AA data): mapped by hand from base model + vendor retention numbers; treat as UNVERIFIED. Basis: PrismML reports 98.2% of Qwen3.8-27B FP16 on a 14-20 benchmark suite (84.78 vs 86.32), but knowledge -5.7 pts and agentic -1.8 pts, which v5 weights heavily -> ~90% of Qwen3.8-27B Xhigh (20.1)
models.notes: Released 2026-09-17. Ternary {-1,0,+1} g128 compression of Qwen3.8-27B (QAT on TPU v5). Beats unsloth IQ2_XXS (7.27GB, 72.59 avg) by 12 pts at smaller size; within 0.4 pts of UD-Q4_K_XL (17.6GB). Category deltas vs FP16: math 96.6/97.1, coding 89.4/89.1, IF 82.7/81.3, agentic 74.9/76.7, knowledge 79.9/85.6, vision 66.2/71.4. Speed (llama-bench tg128, PQ2_0 unless noted): RTX 5090 129.9, RTX PRO 60

models.name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B A9B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: v5-equivalent predicted from AA's legacy v4-era components (HLE, AA-LCR, GDPval-AA, CritPt) via linear fit on 83 models with official v5 index (RMSE 4.9 pts), cross-checked against partial v5 components: legacy fit 13.1; partial v5 components (AutomationBench 15%, Briefcase 912) imply ~11
models.notes: Released 2026-10-09. Star-Elastic compression of Super VL (heterogeneous expert counts, top-k 22->9). Same 8 attention layers. NVIDIA recipes: 28GB (32GB GPU, 65K ctx) / 32GB (48GB GPU, 262K ctx).

models.name: Qwen3.6 35B A3B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: v5-equivalent predicted from AA's own published v5 component scores (AutomationBench, Terminal-Bench 4.0, HLE-Diamond, GDP.pdf, AA-Briefcase) via linear fit on 90 models with official v5 index (RMSE 1.7 pts); model not yet given an official v5 index: predicted 9.5 (legacy fit 7.9). AA-Briefcase 713 vs Qwen3.8-27B 1393, AutomationBench 5% vs 48%. Was 43 on v4.0 (vs Qwen3.6-27B 46, Gemma 4 31B 39)
models.notes: Released 2026-04-15. Very fast (3B active; AA API 133 t/s) but clearly below Qwen3.8-27B: LCBv6 74.6 vs 90.3, SWE-Pro well below. Good choice only when speed/CPU-offload matters more than quality.

models.name: gpt-oss-20b
models.score_source: ESTIMATE: v5-equivalent predicted from AA's own published v5 component scores (AutomationBench, Terminal-Bench 4.0, HLE-Diamond, GDP.pdf, AA-Briefcase) via linear fit on 90 models with official v5 index (RMSE 1.7 pts); model not yet given an official v5 index: strict fit 2.8, legacy fit 7.2 -> 5
models.notes: Aug 2025 - oldest model kept; still the main US-made mid-size MoE besides Muse/Nemotron. Half the layers sliding-window(128). DGX Spark MXFP4: tg32 ~60 t/s, pp2048 ~1950 (120b). Stale vs 2026 Qwen/GLM; keep for license/US-origin/speed reasons.
